cloakroom: Free temporary luggage/belongings deposit counters operated by temple authorities and police help desks near central queue complexes and main bus station holding zones.
drinking_water: Free drinking water supply with thousands of temporary taps, RO water plants, and mobile water tankers deployed across a 24-km radius around Medaram by the Rural Water Supply (RWS) Department. Water stations and shaded resting pavilions are positioned along all major walking tracks.
toilets: Comprehensive sanitation network featuring over 10,000 temporary toilets, mobile toilet vans, dedicated women's cubicles, and 4,000+ continuous sanitation staff managed by the Panchayat Raj & Rural Development Department.
footwear_counter: Designated footwear stands and shoe-keeper stalls set up prior to queue entrance points and barricaded pathways leading to the Gaddelu.
annadanam: Free Annadanam (Mass Feeding Camps) operated continuously (10:00 AM – 11:00 PM) by the Temple Trust, TTD, government agencies, and philanthropic organizations across designated Medaram sector grounds.
wheelchair_accessibility: Free battery-operated EV shuttle carts and limited wheelchairs available at main bus drop-off points and the Central Medical Camp. Dedicated priority queues and barricaded entry gates maintained for elderly and physically challenged devotees.
parking: Temporary Mega Bus Station spread over 50+ acres with 52 designated holding points managed by TGSRTC. Multiple sector-wise private vehicle parking lots managed by police traffic wings (3–5 km prior to the shrine area).
other_facilities: Temporary Forest Tents: 100 comfortable tents set up by the Forest Department near Balloon No. 5 behind Kalyana Katta with mobile toilet vans and fire safety apparatus.

Bathing Ghats at Jampanna Vagu: Extensive river bathing ghats equipped with continuous water flow, safety nets, professional life-saving divers/swimmers, high-capacity water showers, and dedicated changing rooms for women.

24/7 Medical Infrastructure: 50-bed Central Jathara Hospital at TTD Kalyana Mandapam (Sri Sammakka Saralamma Vidyashala), 14 peripheral medical outposts, first-aid centers, and 100+ '108' ambulances on standby.

Central Command & Control System: High-tech monitoring setup featuring 400+ AI CCTV cameras, drone aerial surveillance, face-recognition alerts, and 12,000+ police personnel managed by Telangana State Police.
Barricaded Queue Complexes: Multi-lane holding queue complexes and barricaded pathways leading directly to Sammakka-Saralamma Gaddelu for streamlined crowd movement.
Lost and Found Announcement Network: 10+ sector-wise public address booths integrated with the Central Command Center for re-uniting missing children and family members.
Digital Hundi & Canara Bank Scanners: Official digital donation infrastructure and QR code scanners deployed across temple premises for cashless contributions.
Telecommunication Towers: Temporary mobile cell towers (CoWs) installed by BSNL and major private telecom operators to maintain network connectivity.
Shaded Resting Pavilions: Weather-proof tarpaulin structures, pandals, and resting sheds positioned along all pedestrian routes.
Helipad & Charter Operations: Temporary helipad setup for state tourism charter flights and VIP movement.
Fire Safety Stations: Dedicated fire tenders, water foam tankers, and specialized disaster management teams stationed across high-density sectors.
